acceptance: Publish is refused when the tag commit has no successful latest exact-commit trunk.yml push run on develop, or when its dist-artifact job failed, or when the dist artifact is expired or missing (tested on the TestPyPI path; an older run is never used)
Lightweight (non-annotated) tags are refused (tested on the TestPyPI path)

Workflow invokes scripts/release_artifact_consumer.py admit and scripts/release_admitted_dist.py --stage, and publishes only the staged files; docs/internal/release-artifacts.md no longer says no workflow calls release_admitted_dist.py

Publish-time tag re-check runs in the publishing job after approval and refuses when the tag object or peeled commit differs from the admission receipt, including a re-annotated tag on the same commit (tested)
UAT evidence binds the admitted distribution digest; a broken admitted wheel fails UAT even when the checkout works, and a required skipped/unreachable/pruned cell fails qualification (tested)
t3 blocker gate blocks on an open release-blocking issue beyond the first API page, refuses on API error, and does not block on an unrelated open t3:* issue (tested)
Ruleset drift gate in release-v2 ignores RELEASE_READINESS_OVERRIDE_* and passes against the live rulesets
Provenance attestation verifiable with gh attestation verify naming the expected signer workflow, with subjects matching the staged hashes
Pre-release tags route to test-pypi only; final tags route to pypi; pypi environment reviewers unchanged (static + rehearsal evidence)
release-v2 is workflow_dispatch with a tag input while legacy release.yml keeps the v* tag trigger; no tag push fires both publishers

description:
New release workflow (.github/workflows/release-v2.yml) that publishes the exact trunk-tested artifacts. No tag-signature requirement (owner decision); safety comes from the controls below. Paths corrected 2026-10-17: ADR is docs/internal/adr/adr-dev-loop-v2.md:188-197, contract is docs/internal/release-artifacts.md, guide is docs/internal/release-guide.md, merge-queue note is _project/decisions/merge-queue-retirement-2026-10-03.md. The old branch feat/dev-loop-v2-release-workflow is gone from origin; commit 093d8a2cc survives locally and is docs-only (the artifact contract, since merged by other PRs), so rebuild from this acceptance list (codex F2, narrowed).

Trigger and overlap (codex F9(1a) Required, accepted over the original (a) recommendation; narrows claude NEW-11): ADR G7 (docs/internal/adr/adr-dev-loop-v2.md, Release freeze) keeps the legacy path fully working until the first new-path PyPI release. Therefore release-v2 starts as workflow_dispatch with a tag input; legacy release.yml keeps its v* tag trigger during the overlap. dlv2-53 flips ownership after dlv2-52 proves the new path. The legacy fallback during overlap is a legacy release-cut plus gh workflow run release.yml --ref vX.Y.Z (its publish step requires refs/tags/v*, release.yml:179).

Required workflow behavior:
1. Annotated-tag check: refuse lightweight tags (consumer scripts/release_artifact_consumer.py resolve_tag). Tags are created with git tag -a in dlv2-52a/dlv2-52; existing tooling (scripts/release_finalize.py tag_merge_commit) creates lightweight tags and v0.4.2 is lightweight, so no legacy tag satisfies this workflow (claude NEW-1).
2. Admit: run scripts/release_artifact_consumer.py admit for the tag commit (latest exact-commit trunk.yml push run on develop, successful dist-artifact job at trunk.yml:337-390, attempt-bound artifact, hash checks). Never rebuild. Never fall back to an older run when the latest is missing, failed, or expired; document recovery as a fresh qualifying trunk artifact plus full downstream revalidation (codex F7/F10).
3. Publish-time tag re-check (mandatory, not either/or; claude NEW-3 + codex F9(2)): inside the publishing job, after environment approval, compare both the annotated tag object and its peeled commit against the admission receipt (tag_object, head_sha). The offline gate scripts/release_admitted_dist.py does not check the hosted tag, so this check is new code in the publish job. A tag replaced during the approval wait, including a new annotation pointing at the same commit, must refuse publish.
4. Artifact-bound gates: T4 install+smoke on Python 3.11-3.14 x Linux/macOS/Windows (12 cells) installing the admitted wheel (Windows cells download the admitted artifact and re-run release_admitted_dist.py; admission itself is POSIX-only, consumer :530). UAT release-gate configs (tests/uat/configs/release-gate-*.yaml) must execute the admitted distribution, not the checkout: the current UAT launcher uses project uv run (tests/uat/matrix.py uv_run_argv) and records only source provenance, so bind the distribution digest into UAT evidence and prove a broken admitted wheel fails (codex F10 Required). Required UAT cells must reject missing, skipped, unreachable, or pruned cells: current configs set skip_unreachable: true and gate_summary does not require zero unreachable, so add an explicit required-cell check; never claim a green combined verdict alone proves no-skip (codex F10 Required). Also _binaries hash manifest, make release-check, ruleset drift (see 5), t3 blocker gate (see 6).
5. Ruleset drift gate: run scripts/ruleset_drift_check.py without honoring RELEASE_READINESS_OVERRIDE_SHA/_REASON (claude NEW-5); the override skips tag and environment checks and must not bypass a release gate. The drift expectations must be decoupled from release-only before dlv2-53 deletes that ruleset (tracked in dlv2-53; dlv2-51 must not hard-depend on release-only existing).
6. t3 blocker gate: block when any open issue carries the release-blocking label (docs/internal/nightly-t3.md:58-63; a maintainer applies the label by hand, and scripts/release_readiness_check.py does not check it yet). Specify the exact predicate (state=open AND label release-blocking), paginate fully, refuse on API error, evaluate before publish, and grant issues: read. State in docs that the gate passes vacuously when no label has been applied (claude NEW-6, codex F10 consensus).
7. Stage and publish: run scripts/release_admitted_dist.py --stage in the publishing job and publish only staged bytes. Route by pre-release: tags containing a pre-release component (for example v0.5.0-rc.1) publish to test-pypi only and can never queue a pypi deployment; final tags go to pypi (owner approval) (claude NEW-4). Build provenance attestation whose subjects match the staged hashes and whose verifier identity names the expected signer workflow (codex L2 + claude NEW-8): merely creating an attestation is insufficient; acceptance is gh attestation verify with the stated signer. Publish via environment test-pypi or pypi; pypi required reviewers unchanged (owner approves real releases).
8. Owner gate (claude NEW-2 Required): PyPI/TestPyPI trusted publishers are bound to the workflow file name, so release-v2.yml has no publisher until the owner registers it. Record this as an explicit owner step before dlv2-52a; the workflow PR must state the exact publisher entries needed and which file name is final after dlv2-53 replaces release.yml.

Operating constraints: tag soon after the trunk run (90-day artifact expiry, trunk.yml:390); latest attempt only; no trunk reruns on a tagged commit (a rerun changes admitted hashes); run on an ephemeral single-tenant runner per docs/internal/release-artifacts.md threat model.
